name: brief2motion
description: Turn a plain brief into live, measured web motion: dust that forms your product, face or logo, a paper plane across the page, scroll scenes. Sibling of brief2mp4.

interface.shortDescription: Write a brief, get live web motion
interface.longDescription: Paste a plain brief and the agent builds a web page with live motion: ink-dot particles that assemble into your product, face or logo, a paper plane flying across the page, scroll-driven scenes. It then measures the page in a real browser and fixes what fails.
defaultPrompt: Use the brief2motion skill to build the page in this brief:
Check the motion in a real browser.
